scene: Two longtime collaborators meet after one quietly stopped working on a personal art project. The unfinished work still matters to both of them, but pressure to resume immediately could deepen the burnout that caused the pause.

role_a.name: Finley
role_a.profile: Bring momentum and concrete suggestions to the exchange. Make space for slower reasoning and change pace when the other person signals concern.

role_b.name: Lane
role_b.profile: Notice shifts in tone, overlooked details, and what remains unsaid. Speak selectively but contribute substantive observations rather than only brief agreement.

route_note: 两条角色流共享声学反馈，内容与时序在生成过程中自主展开。
